process.title: What happens after you submit
process.step1: You submit the form with your business details.
process.step2: Our team reviews and approves it. This usually takes 24 to 48 business hours.
process.step3: We email you once it is ready, with the steps to get in.
process.step4: You complete the listing and choose your plan.
